translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: LUGU
book.title: Lugu Luguhanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Yasu Pailate hearia haru penego ogo
Bibahende bu hearunime heyai howa Yasu Pailate hearia haru pene.

Tigua haru puwa lalu, Yu wali agalime nabiagane wimaru agali ogo ibugua mo bia halu hearia handa walia harima. Ani bialu ibugua lalu, Lomonaga Kinihondo muni dagisi mulene nawi, lalu, ibu Mbirali Dabo Helenego ibulebira lowinigo handame haga kini ogoni i̱ kogoni, laya, lene.
Tigua ani layagola Pailatehanda Yasuhondo lalu, Yu wali agalinaga handame haga kini í̠ kebe, lene. Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Í̠na o laregoni, lene.
Ani layagola Pailatehanda loma binigo mo miaga haguane hearuhondobi wali agali dewa bu hearuhondobi, Agali ogome kagua biya lolene irane nawida, lene.

Ani layagola tigua hongoore howa, Agali ogonime mana lawai haragonaga Yudiani wali agali bibahende karu mo gungu ale bia haga ka. Pigane ibu Galilini bialu henego áyu ogoriani ani bule ibiragoni, lene.
Yasu Herodo hearia haru penego ogo
Tigua bi layago hale howa Pailatehanda lalu, Agali ogoni ibu Galilialibe, lene.
Ibugua manda bu handalu hearia Yasu Herodohanda handame ho kagoha howayane Herodo áyure dege Yarusaleme íbu hayuagola, Yasu Herodo karia haru pudaba, lene.
Herodo ibu bambaore howa Yasu hondoa ho haabo henego haru ibiyago hondowa ibu turu timbuniore hene. Yasuhanda agalime nabiagane ale biragola de hondole Herodo ibu hamelo hene.
Ani buwa Herodohanda Yasuhondo bi maru hale hayagola Yasuhanda mbira ladai nabiore hene.
Loma binigo mo miaga haguane hearumebi Mana lowinigo lawai haga hearumebi íbu ha para halu hongo howa lalu, Agali ogonime ko gibiore biya, lalu hene.
Ani layagola Herodobi ibunaga wai biaga ami agali hearubi tigua Yasu mege taraore bialu handabe manga howa aga bayaleore mbira mo karula howa, Pailate karia haru dai bidaba, lene.
Pailate Herodola waitigi ho haga haga biaga henego horo ogoningiore nenege hinini.
Yasu homelo ba, lenego ogo
Pailatehanda loma binigo mo miaga haguane hearubi wali agali haru haga hearubi wali agali hearubi, Mandagi ngoai hadaba, lowa

tihondo lalu, Tígua agali ogo i̱ hewaria haru ibuwa lalu, Ibugua wali agali mo hondo halu kago, larimigo i̱na tínaga wanakuini helowa ibugua kagua mbira agi biyadabe hondole ibuhondo hale halu tai biaabo haru. Ani buwa ibugua kagua ogo biya larimiru mbira handa walia nahe ko.
Herodohandabi handa walia nahe dege howa ina hemaria dai bilayagoni. Anidago agali ogome ko mbira nabidago ibu homelo nababeheda.
I̱na agali maruhondo, Ibu tibume bowa pelalimu, lolebero, lene. [
Bolangua Halu Penegonaga Horo harangi agali mbira garabaya heago wali agali hearume, Gola, laragola Pailatehanda golaga hene.]
Pailatehanda ani layagola wali agali bibahendeme hongo howa dalimu lalu, Agali ogoni homelo balu Barabasa inane kamaria golalu dai bila, lene.
Barabasahanda Yarusalemeni howa mo gungu bia hayagolabi agali mbira bo tongolo milayagolabi garabaya andaha garabaya bu helene.
Ani layagola Pailatehanda Yasu, Wahalu pu, loa howa lone wali agali bu hearuhondo bi layagola
tigua hongo howa dalimu ladai bialu lalu, Ibu ira bangani ba para ha. Ibu ira bangani ba para ha, lene.

Ani layagola Pailatehanda tihondo halu tebone lalu, Ibugua kagua agi biyabe. Ibu homelo bolenaga kagua biyago i̱ handa walia nahe ko. Ogoninaga i̱na agali maruhondo, Ibu tibume bowa pelalimu laro, lene.
Ani laya tiraga tigua, Ira bangani ba para habe, lalu bi hongo howa layagome Pailatenaga bi lo dambi hene.
Ani layagola Pailatehanda lalu, Tíni hame lowa bule harimidadagua bilimu, lene.

Ani lowa agali mbirame Lomo gabumane baba wai bialu agali mbira bo wahayagola garabaya andaha helenego agali ogoni tigua golelo hame layago Pailate ibugua golope hene. Ani buwa ibugua agali hearuhondo lalu, Tíni hame ledamidagua bilimu, lalu Yasu tihondo mini.
Yasu ira bangani ba para henego ogo

Ami agali hearume Yasu minu yalu pialu hearia Sairiniali mbira mini Saimono Yarusalemeha anda ibalu hearia harigani lola hene. Lola hayagola tigua ibu minuwa Yasunaga ira banga ibunaga payani mo ya hayagola ibugua yalu Yasu piyadagua mama pene.
Wali agali dewaore Yasu piyadagua pialu howa wali marume Yasunaga dugu yiyi lama ibiyagola
Yasu ibu handa dai buwa lalu, Yarusaleme waliru-o i̱naga dugu bulemini tíninagabi tí waneigininagabi dugu bilimu, lene.

Ani lowa ibugua lalu, Horo maru tagira ibirangi wali agali karume agua lolebira, Wali waneigini nahe bedarubi wali gali taba nahene bedarubi wali gali andu nami bedarubi ti turu taraore ho birulebira, lalu lolebira.
Ogoni ibirangi wali agalime gi howa hari wedaruhondo, Ina bu dambi hadaba, lalu dindi hombene ngaruhondo, Ina ge hela, lalu holebira.
Ira kago bayale mindibi gumbile kaore mbirale urunibi biyagua ira ogo gau laragola agua bulebirabe, lalu Yasuhanda lene.
Agali kira mana ko biaga henego kirabali Yasu heba mandagi homelo bole haru pene.

Ti dindi mbira mini Haguane Kuni laga winigoria anda puwa tigua Yasu ira bangani ba para howa agali ko biaga biago labo mendego gi tigahayagi mendego gi lehayagi lowa ti ira banga tebirani ba para hai hene.
Ani biyagola Yasuhanda lalu, Aba-o tigua ogo ale berama nale bupe harago tinaga ko biragoni domo wahabe, lene. Ani layagola tigua ibunaga aga ai ibu harabe hondole tadu bialu berene.

Wali agali bu hearume handaya ho hearia Yu wali agali haru haga hearume Yasu mege bialu lalu, Ibu Mbirali Dabo Helenego ibulebira lowinigo Ngode Datagaliwabehanda dabene ibu kayagua ibugua wali agali maru pele miralidagua ibuni pele mila, lene.
Ami agali biarumebi mege dege bialu ibu wiagoria ha para howa waini iba kaubi nelo yade halu
lalu, Í̠ Yu wali agalinaga handame haga kini keyagua í̠nime í̠ni pele merene, lene.
Ira banga daligani bi ogo gilibu wini. Yu wali agalinaga Handame Haga Kini ogoni ibu, gili bini.
Agali mana pugualu ko biaga ira bangani ba para hayago mendegome Yasu mege bialu lalu, Mbirali Dabo Helenego ibulebira lowinigo í̠ ndobe. Í̠ni pele mialu iyabi pele ngerene, lene.
Ani layagola mendegome o layago hale howa ibu talialu lalu, Í̠na Ngode Datagaliwabehondo mogo nale kebe. Ibu tandaga naradagua dege í̠bi naregoni.
Iyame kagua biribagonaga pani nolene winidaguaore narabago o tigabida. Agali ogome pani narago ibugua ko mbiraore nabiore howa naragoni, lene.
Ani lowa ibugua Yasuhondo lalu, Yasu-o í̠ Handame Haga Kini howa eberengi i̱ mitangi bibe, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ibuhondo lalu, I̱na buleberoore lalu langerogoni áyu dahuliya andaga iya haru pu holeberaba laro, lene.
Yasu tongolo minigo ogo
Horombe hanuniore hayagola ni da nabi hundialu dindi ogoniha wiagoni bibahendeore aruma haho wiane alendo ni gai layagola ni dadai bini.
Ani biyagola Anduane Homogonaga andaha labolabo timbuni gerela ho winigo daliga howa buda ki bini.
Aniore biyagola Yasuhanda bi dalimuore lalu, Aba-o i̱ dinini í̠naga gini ya harogoni, lowa tongolo mini.
Ami agali haru haga heagome o biyago hondowa ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabe mini yaraga halu lalu, Ibu agali bayaleore haya, lene.
Wali agali agi birabe hondole íbu ngoai ho hearume o biyaruni hondowa dara timbuni halu tinaga galuhombeneni bama andaga dai bini.
Yasu ibu baba hagarubi wali maru Galili howa Yasu ibiyadagua haru ibiyarubi o biyaruni amuraore howa handa amu ho hene.
Yasu tingini hora henego ogo

Agali mbira mini Yosebe ibu Yudianaga tano mbira mini Arimadia howa íbu hene. Ibu agali baya mini lene henego Ngode Datagaliwabenaga Handame Ho Holene ibilo hondo hene. Ani buwa ibu Ganisolo agali howa Ganisolo agali marume bulene manda biyadagua ibu bulene hame nale hene.
Agali ogonime Pailate hearia puwa lalu, Yasu tingini mule poaba, lene.
Ani lowa Yasu tingini ira bangani howa mo yalu daluwa labolabo peleoreme kabu buwa ege andaha ala guabu wuwa mbirali hora nahene winigoha yalu puwa hora hene.
Ogoni ani biyagola Sabada horo holene kaware wini.
Wali maru Yasu ibiyadagua Galili howa mama ibiyarume Yosebehanda Yasu tingini mo yalu piyago hondowa homali ege anda wiago hondole pene.
Handalu andaga dai buwa welibi mbirale ngabioreru mo manda manda bini. Ani buwa Sabada horongi Mana lowini ngadagua ti ha̱lo hene.
